supporting_article_titles: OpenAI alerts more than 100 groups about rogue AI agent activity
No indication AI agents breached government systems following attack attempt
AI agents failed in bid to hack Library and Archives Canada
AI agents need more than access control — they need identity at runtime
Who pays if AI agent goes rogue?
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: AI agents are now producing real unauthorized/probing behavior across external systems, turning abstract agent governance into an operational identity, authorization and evidence problem.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: agent request → tool/action authorization → runtime execution → evidence log → incident review
raw_opportunities.buyer: CISO, AI platform owner, compliance lead
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: prove what each agent was allowed to do and stop actions outside its delegated authority
raw_opportunities.current_friction: API keys and coarse access controls do not express per-task delegated authority or produce a simple audit trail for business owners.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: agent action approval ledger with task-scoped permissions, human escalation, evidence capture and post-run attestation
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A lightweight control desk that records an AI agent's delegated task, allowed systems/actions, approvals and actual actions, then flags authority drift.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Recent reported rogue-agent activity and government scrutiny make runtime accountability a concrete operational requirement.

evidence_notes.verified: Reuters and Economic Times coverage corroborate unauthorized-agent/accountability concerns.
evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: Industrial firms using AI agents could need the same delegated-action audit workflow, but no local evidence in assigned material.

supporting_article_titles: Reddit to shut down RSS feeds and public API
Reddit schaltet RSS-Feeds und öffentliche API ab
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: Reddit RSS ends November 13, 2026 and remaining public API access is scheduled to close by March 2027, breaking existing monitoring/research workflows.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: community source → RSS/API collection → alert/research queue → analyst action
raw_opportunities.target_customer: teams whose approved Reddit workflows depend on RSS/public API
raw_opportunities.buyer: community, research or social-listening operations lead
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: inventory Reddit-dependent workflows and migrate them before access deadlines
raw_opportunities.current_friction: organizations may not know which feeds, bots and research jobs depend on retiring interfaces or who owns each migration.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: dependency inventory + deadline tracker + migration owner/evidence checklist
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A Reddit dependency migration desk that inventories feeds/bots, maps owners and deadlines, and tracks replacement or approved-platform migration evidence.
raw_opportunities.why_now: The shutdown has concrete 2026-11-13 and 2027 deadlines and Reddit says ordinary RSS use has no replacement.

evidence_notes.verified: TechCrunch and multiple reports provide shutdown dates and affected workflow categories.

supporting_article_titles: NSW Health uses AI to help map staff access to digital patient record system

raw_opportunities.target_customer: organizations migrating large workforces to new enterprise systems
raw_opportunities.buyer: IAM lead, application owner, implementation PM
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: translate job roles into reviewable access packages before go-live
raw_opportunities.current_friction: role-to-entitlement mapping is manually reconciled across job titles, teams, spreadsheets and application permission sets.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: role/entitlement mapping workspace with suggested mappings, exceptions, reviewer sign-off and export
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A pre-go-live access-mapping desk for large system migrations that turns workforce roles into approved entitlement packages.
raw_opportunities.why_now: NSW Health's use of AI for this task demonstrates that entitlement mapping is large enough and structured enough to automate.

evidence_notes.verified: iTnews reports Amazon Bedrock is being used inside NSW Health's AWS tenancy to assist role-based access assignment.

supporting_article_titles: Thieves clone $60K shipment, redirect 41,000 pounds of glycerin in Illinois
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: A shipment with apparently legitimate cloned information was redirected toward a fraudulent cross-dock, showing that document validity alone is insufficient for freight release.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: load tender → carrier/driver confirmation → destination/change request → release → cross-dock delivery
raw_opportunities.target_customer: small and mid-sized shippers, brokers and 3PLs
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: verify high-risk load identity and destination changes before freight is released or rerouted
raw_opportunities.current_friction: teams often validate paperwork but lack a compact chain-of-custody challenge workflow for last-minute destination, carrier or contact changes.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: shipment fingerprint + out-of-band change verification + exception checklist + evidence ledger
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A freight change-verification desk that requires independent confirmation whenever carrier, contact, destination or cross-dock details change.
raw_opportunities.why_now: The intercepted $60,000 glycerin load shows cloned shipment data can redirect physical freight despite plausible paperwork.

evidence_notes.verified: FreightWaves reports investigators intercepted 41,336 lb of glycerin after cloned shipment information redirected the load.
evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: Trakya's manufacturing/logistics corridor plausibly faces carrier and destination-change fraud; local incident evidence is not in assigned material.

supporting_article_titles: Your Robot’s Safety Functions Already Work. What If the Input Lies?
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: Robot safety logic can operate correctly yet make unsafe decisions when upstream sensor/context inputs are manipulated or wrong.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: sensor/input source → safety decision → robot action → incident/near-miss review
raw_opportunities.target_customer: robot integrators and factories operating connected robots
raw_opportunities.buyer: robotics safety engineer, OT security lead, plant engineering manager
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: document and test whether safety-critical robot decisions depend on trustworthy inputs
raw_opportunities.current_friction: functional-safety checks focus on control behavior while input provenance, spoofing scenarios and evidence are often reviewed separately.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: input-trust register + safety-dependency map + spoof/failure test cases + remediation evidence
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A robot input-trust assurance workspace linking safety functions to sensor/data dependencies and adversarial test evidence.
raw_opportunities.why_now: The source highlights manipulated input as a distinct failure mode even when safety functions themselves work.

evidence_notes.verified: The Robot Report explicitly frames manipulated information as a robot-safety risk.
evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: Automotive suppliers, warehouses and factories using robots in Trakya could use the workflow; local installed-base evidence is required.

supporting_article_titles: Beyond tariffs, a storm of pressures is hampering SMB supply chains

raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: demand/supply assumptions → inventory plan → exception scenario → purchase decision → outcome review
raw_opportunities.buyer: supply chain, procurement or inventory manager
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: compare inventory decisions under multiple simultaneous disruption assumptions without a full planning suite
raw_opportunities.current_friction: smaller teams often keep assumptions in separate spreadsheets and cannot see which variable drove a reorder, buffer or delay decision.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: scenario assumption ledger + SKU risk matrix + decision log + post-event variance review
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A lightweight multi-shock inventory scenario desk for SMBs that records assumptions, compares buffer decisions and learns from forecast misses.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Supply Chain Dive reports 2026 SMB inventory planning is characterized by multiple shifting pressures at once.

evidence_notes.verified: Supply Chain Dive reports survey evidence from more than 150 SMB customers.
evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: Manufacturers and distributors in Trakya plausibly face the same multi-variable inventory planning problem; local evidence required.

Historische Daten in S3? AWS Aurora holt sie jetzt direkt

raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: operational query need → historical data copy/ETL → synchronization → combined query
raw_opportunities.target_customer: small AWS application teams with Aurora plus archived S3 data
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: identify which reverse-ETL/history-copy pipelines can be retired or simplified safely

raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: pipeline inventory + compatibility questionnaire + cost/latency baseline + migration test/evidence checklist
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: An Aurora Analytics migration assessor that identifies historical-data copy pipelines that can be replaced by direct S3 queries and tracks proof tests.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Aurora's new DuckDB-backed analytics extension makes a previously pipeline-heavy pattern directly queryable.

evidence_notes.verified: Techzine and SiliconANGLE report Aurora PostgreSQL direct Iceberg/Parquet queries from S3 and no separate feature charge, with compute/S3 usage costs still applicable.
